dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Come try the "Snow Alley Dash"! You'll be warmed up in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to try it!

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: I've already mapped out the route! All you need to do is follow the guides at the markers I set up, and you'll clear this without a hitch!

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Once you do, you'll receive a gift that I've prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Of course, if you'd also help me promote this sport, that would be even better!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What exactly is the "Snow Alley Dash"?

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Haha, it's a little sport I invented myself! It doesn't take much skill, you can play as long as you know how to run.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: In a freezing place like this, my hair is practically turning into icicles... But let me tell you, running one round of it warms you up better than a whole flask of strong liquor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I feel so warm all over...

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Great! I believe you've finally realized what makes this sport so awesome...

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: If you head out into the snow all stiff and numb, you're bound to take a nasty spill!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I haven't too much time at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Ah, what a shame... Well, drop by when you have some time!

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: You've completed the "Snow Alley Dash"! How'd it go? Feeling all warmed up?

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Come help advertise the "Snow Alley Dash" — a sport that'll warm you up in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What exactly is the "Snow Alley Dash"?

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Haha, it's a little sport I invented myself! It doesn't take much skill, you can play as long as you know how to run.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: In a freezing place like this, my hair is practically turning into icicles... But let me tell you, running one round of it warms you up better than a whole flask of strong liquor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please excuse the interruption.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Goodbye.
